principles: Findability is a property of joining (replication), not of per-node peer wiring; findability != reachability (relay-findability proposal, 2026-07-19)
A direct connection is equivalent to a relay punchthrough; the relay is only a NAT fallback (operator ratified 2026-07-19)
Duplicate handling is a property of the producer's genre, declared as a shape; which duplicate serves stays learned (vessel-duplicate-genres design §1)
Identity is the namespace boundary: same secret = replica, different secret = foreign namespace (duplicate-genres decision 1)
Per-caller failover/quota filtering is a forbidden band-aid; de-advertise is the producer's job, resolve through discovery (duplicate-genres T10 struck)
Decay and tuning parameters are runtime behaviour: shaped tuning rows, never frozen constants (thompson-decay tasks §1; posterior-update.ts:930-958)
When one constant serves two incompatible jobs, dissolve the conflict at its source instead of trading (activity-api 2ededef)
A commit naming a gap is provenance, not measurement; only a measurement predicate may say 'absent' (gap-to-feature.ts landedCommitVerdict doc)
Certify closure against the referent's persistence signal, not a landed sha (sound-close-oracle-reland)
A fix applied to one site is not a fix: centralize duplicated verdict logic (sound-close-oracle-reland)
The substrate should express the full capability surface it advertises, preferring deterministic resolvers over LLM re-derivation (orphaned_capability_scan cite_principle)
